info.title: ARSHNAZ Personal Agent API
info.description: Manage only the authenticated account data using a personal agent token. First read /me and inspect permissions. This API does not edit application source code. Read relevant records before writing and verify results. Do not override time conflicts without user approval.

get.summary: Verify token and inspect granted permissions
get.description: Requires a valid, unexpired personal agent token; no resource scope is required. Returns only the current token metadata and granted scopes.

post.description: Requires tasks:create or tasks:write. Access is limited to the account associated with the token.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Unique for each intended task creation; retries with the same payload return the original task for 24 hours across server instances. Reusing a key with a different payload returns 409.

priority.description: Current priority. Legacy p1–p4 inputs are accepted as aliases (p1=high, p2=medium, p3=low, p4=none).

work_date.description: The one task schedule: calendar day or explicit-offset ISO 8601 datetime. Null clears the whole schedule.

schedule_timezone.description: Optional IANA zone for local-day interpretation of an explicit instant.

planning_horizon.description: Planning period level; supply together with planning_start and planning_end.

due_date.description: Deprecated alias for work_date; do not send both.
